title: 第五十章 虚局惑心第四十九章 润物离间
content_zh:
三天后，出了一件事。
城东的客栈夜里进了贼。不是偷东西的贼，是送信的。那人摸进上官复使者的房间，在枕头下面塞了一封信，然后悄无声息地离开了。
使者第二天早上才发现那封信。
他拆开一看，脸色就变了。
信上只写了一行字。
“萧无恨已答应见面，三日后子时，城西废庙。”
使者看了半天，没有看懂。
他没有约过萧无恨，萧无恨也没有答应过他。这封信是谁写的？为什么要以他的名义约萧无恨？
他不知道。
但他没有声张。
他把信收起来，决定按兵不动，看看是谁在背后搞鬼。
他不知道的是，那封信在到他手上之前，已经被动过了。
蓝婷在信角上做了一个很轻的折痕。
不仔细看，根本看不出来。
她算好了时间，在那封信被塞进使者房间之前，先让慕容小雪“偶然”看见了那封信。
那天下午，慕容小雪从城东客栈门口经过。
她没有进去。
只是路过。
但她看见了蓝婷从客栈里出来。
蓝婷的手里拿着一封信。

她走得很快，神色有些慌张，像是不想被人看见。
慕容小雪叫住了她。
“蓝婷。”
蓝婷站住，转过身来，脸上带着一丝慌乱。
“慕容姐姐。”
“你在这里做什么。”
慕容小雪问。
蓝婷低下头，把手里的信攥紧了一些。
“没什么。我出来买菜，路过这里。”
慕容小雪看了一眼她手里的信。
“那是谁的信。”
蓝婷犹豫了一下。
“是……是给萧大哥的。”
慕容小雪的目光凝固了一瞬。
“谁写的。”
“我不知道。”
蓝婷的声音有点发虚。
“是客栈里的人让我转交的。他说是上官庄主那边的人，有要紧事要告诉萧大哥。”
她把信递过去。
content_en:
Three days later, something happened.
There was a thief in the inn in the east of the city at night. He is not a thief who steals things, he is a messenger. The man entered Shangguan Fu's envoy's room, stuffed a letter under his pillow, and then left quietly.
The messenger found the letter the next morning.
When he took it apart and took a look, his expression changed.
There was only one line written in the letter.
"Xiao Wuhen has agreed to meet. Three days later, the temple will be abandoned in the west of the city."
The messenger looked at it for a long time but didn't understand it.
He had never made an appointment with Xiao Wuhen, and Xiao Wuhen had not promised him. Who wrote this letter? Why do you want to date Xiao Wuhen in his name?
He doesn't know.
But he kept silent.
He put the letter away and decided to stand still and see who was behind it.
What he didn't know was that the letter had been tampered with before it got to him.
Lan Ting made a very light crease on the corner of the letter.
If you don't look carefully, you can't see it at all.
She calculated the time and let Murong Xiaoxue "accidentally" see the letter before it was stuffed into the messenger's room.
That afternoon, Murong Xiaoxue passed by the door of Chengdong Inn.
She didn't go in.
Just passing by.
But she saw Lan Ting coming out of the inn.
Lan Ting held a letter in her hand.
She walked quickly, looking a little flustered, as if she didn't want to be seen.
Murong Xiaoxue stopped her.
"Lanting."
Lan Ting stopped and turned around, with a trace of panic on her face.
"Sister Murong."
"What are you doing here?"
Murong Xiaoxue asked.
Lan Ting lowered her head and clenched the letter in her hand a little tighter.
"Nothing. I went out to buy groceries and passed by here."
Murong Xiaoxue glanced at the letter in her hand.
"Whose letter is that?"
Lan Ting hesitated.
"It's...it's for Brother Xiao."
Murong Xiaoxue's eyes froze for a moment.
"Who wrote it?"
"I don't know."
Lan Ting's voice was a little weak.
"The person in the inn asked me to hand it over. He said it was from the owner of Shangguan Villa and he had something important to tell Brother Xiao."
She handed the letter over.
